purpose: A guide to the main theorem, its Lean proof, and the corresponding manuscript statements.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.thm_main
entries.title: The main theorem
entries.summary: Proves the three conclusions of the manuscript’s main theorem for the potential constructed from elementaryParameters, together with their operator interpretation. The potential is fixed before separation and coupling are chosen. The proof depends on the two classical admissions A002 and A004.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.elementaryPotential_main
entries.title: The result for the fixed potential
entries.summary: Literally fixes the field b = 1 and the potential elementaryParameters.potential, then proves its admissibility and the existence of a threshold L₀ > 16 valid for every L ≥ L₀. The potential and its cutoffs depend on neither L nor the coupling λ; the exceptional sequences and the large-coupling thresholds may depend on L. This version specifies the witness explicitly and is more precise than the manuscript’s existence statement.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.ConstructedPotentialMainTheorem
entries.title: The order of choices
entries.summary: Requires a single parameter record p satisfying the elementary conditions, admissibility of its potential, and then a threshold L₀ > p.R with the conclusion for every L ≥ L₀. Choosing p fixes the field and cutoffs before L₀, L, and λ.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.OperatorMainConclusion
entries.title: The three conclusions for the L² operator
entries.summary: Combines MainConclusion with the realizations of the Hamiltonians on the actual L² space. At every sufficiently large crossing, the full ground eigenspace has complex dimension two, contains both parities, and has a strictly positive gap on its orthogonal complement; interlaced samples also have simple ground states of alternating parity. The coupling thresholds may depend on L, and the gap may also depend on λ; no further uniformity or enumeration of the entire spectrum is included.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.MainConclusion
entries.title: Crossings, hopping, and parity
entries.summary: Encodes (i) a positive, strictly increasing sequence of zeros of the min-max gap tending to infinity, together with multiplicity at large crossings; (ii) another sequence of zeros of the complex hopping; and (iii) interlaced couplings with simple even and odd ground states. Its first two fields ensure that a normalized atomic ground state exists at large coupling and that the hopping is independent of its choice. The hopping-zero sequence is not identified with the spectral-crossing sequence.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.AdmissiblePotential
entries.title: The required geometric properties
entries.summary: Says that v is a smooth, compactly supported real function taking values in [−1,0], and is nonradial: two points of equal norm have different potential values. Uniqueness and nondegeneracy of the constructed potential’s minimum are proved separately.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.CuspParameters.potential
entries.title: The potential with two cusps
entries.summary: Defines exactly v = v° + ε(q₊ + q₋), where v° is the radial core and q₋ is the reflection of the cusp q₊. Neither the separation parameter L nor the coupling λ occurs in this function. Admissibility then follows from the BasicConditions verified for the numerical witness.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.CuspParameters.core
entries.title: The explicit radial core
entries.summary: Equals −exp(−|x|²/(r₀²−|x|²)) when |x| < r₀, and zero elsewhere. For r₀ > 0, smoothness across the boundary, the unique minimum −1 at the origin, and its nondegeneracy are proved separately. The unit-field spectral admission A004 is applied to this core after dividing by b².

entries.name: InfiniteZero.CuspParameters.cuspPlus
entries.title: The upper log-flat cusp
entries.summary: In the chart Ψ₊(t,s) = p₊ + t n₊ + t²s τ₊, defines q₊ = −a exp(−β log²(tStar/t)) χa(t) χb(s) for 0 < t < t₀ and |s| < s₀, and extends it by zero. The tangential coordinate recovered in the code is divided by t² to obtain s. The extension is proved smooth at the tip.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.CuspParameters.elementaryParameters
entries.title: The numerical witness
entries.summary: Fixes r₀ = 1, R = 16, b = 1, ε = 1/16, a = β = tStar = s₀ = 1, and t₀ = 1/100, together with two explicit smooth cutoffs. The tips are therefore (8, ±8√3). These values specialize the family of potentials in the manuscript.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.magneticHamiltonian
entries.title: The magnetic differential expression
entries.summary: Defines Hψ = Σⱼ Dⱼ(Dⱼψ) + λ²Vψ with Dⱼ = −i∂ⱼ − (bλ/2)(x⊥)ⱼ and x⊥ = (−x₂,x₁). The parameter coupling is λ, and the energies are unscaled. This is an operation on functions; the domain of the closed operator on L² is constructed separately.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.doubleWellPotential
entries.title: Two copies of the same well
entries.summary: For d = (L,0), defines V_L(x) = v(x+d) + v(−x+d). Inversion x ↦ −x exchanges the two terms even when v is nonradial; the centers are −d and d. The Hamiltonian includes the scaled potential λ²V_L.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.groundEnergy
entries.title: The first variational level
entries.summary: This is the infimum of the magnetic form over smooth, compactly supported functions with L² norm one, for the double-well potential. For the constructed potential at large coupling, the spectral proofs identify it with the lowest eigenvalue E₀(λ).

entries.name: InfiniteZero.secondEnergy
entries.title: The second min-max level
entries.summary: Takes the infimum of all E for which there exists a complex two-dimensional space F of test functions such that every mass-one function in F has energy at most E. This expresses inf_dim(F)=2 sup_{ψ∈F, ‖ψ‖₂=1} q(ψ) through upper bounds, counting multiplicity. For our potential at large coupling, the proof identifies this level with the maximum of the actual ground energies in the two parity sectors.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.canonicalAtomicState
entries.title: Choosing the atomic state
entries.summary: Uses classical choice to select a normalized ground state of the single well when one exists, and returns zero otherwise to define a total function. MainConclusion.atomic_states excludes this fallback branch at large coupling. No preferred phase or continuity of the choice is imposed; independence of the hopping from this choice is proved.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.hopping
entries.title: The actual complex coefficient ρλ
entries.summary: Defines ρλ = λ² ∫ conjugate(φᴸ(x)) v(x+d) φᴿ(x) dx. The left state is the magnetic translate T_{−d}φ and the right state is φᴸ(−x), both constructed from the same atomic state φ. The coefficient is complex-valued.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.canonicalHopping
entries.title: Hopping as a function of coupling
entries.summary: Evaluates the hopping integral on canonicalAtomicState to produce a fixed complex-valued function of λ. The atomic_states and hopping_intrinsic fields of MainConclusion ensure that, at large coupling, it uses an actual normalized state and agrees with the integral obtained from every other normalized ground state.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.IsGroundEigenspace
entries.title: The full ground eigenspace
entries.summary: The biconditional requires G to contain all and only the double-well eigenfunctions at groundEnergy. Here an eigenfunction is a smooth complex L² function satisfying Hψ = Eψ pointwise; zero is included to form a vector space.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.SimpleGroundParity
entries.title: A simple ground state of a given parity
entries.summary: Requires the full ground eigenspace to be a complex line containing a mass-one function of the requested parity. true means ψ(−x) = ψ(x), and false means ψ(−x) = −ψ(x), under inversion of the entire plane. Every other ground eigenfunction is a complex multiple and therefore has the same parity.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.magneticOperator
entries.title: The actual operator on L²
entries.summary: Extracts a partial linear map from the closure of the subspace spanned by the pairs ([ψ],[Hψ]) for smooth, compactly supported ψ. Its domain is thus fixed by the concrete differential expression. IsMagneticRealization certifies that this extraction has exactly the prescribed graph and that the operator is self-adjoint.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.OperatorDoubleGround
entries.title: Exact multiplicity at a crossing
entries.summary: Requires the full L² eigenspace at groundEnergy to have complex dimension exactly two and to contain two nonzero vectors of opposite parity. A positive gap above this space is a separate property in OperatorMainConclusion.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.IsMagneticRealization
entries.title: Connecting functions and the operator
entries.summary: Combines identification of the closed graph, self-adjointness, equality of the variational infima, a lower bound on the entire domain, and the correspondence between classical and L² eigenspaces. Admission A002 provides this certificate for smooth, bounded real potentials.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.CuspParameters.exists_doubleWell_global_minmax_of_radialData
entries.title: Identifying the first two actual levels
entries.summary: From the radial data and explicit realizations, proves at large coupling that groundEnergy = min(E_even,E_odd) and secondEnergy = max(E_even,E_odd). The sector-mode certificates and bounds on their complements have already been constructed for the concrete potential. This identifies the two variational levels with the two lowest eigenvalues.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.CuspParameters.operatorMainConclusion_of_radialData
entries.title: The central analytic assembly
entries.summary: Constructs the actual hopping asymptotic and then the Schur corrections, which are negligible relative to the amplitude of the same channel witnesses. It then combines the modes, continuity, and sign-change argument to obtain OperatorMainConclusion. The proof takes the spectral and resolvent interfaces and the proved interior elliptic estimate as explicit inputs.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.CuspParameters.mainConclusion
entries.title: Supplying the analytic interfaces
entries.summary: Starting from BasicConditions on the explicit parameters, supplies the realizations and radial data through A002 and A004, then applies the proved resolvent formula and interior elliptic estimate. It chooses a threshold L₀ > p.R before considering any L ≥ L₀.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.CuspParameters.exists_main_separation_of_radialData
entries.title: Choosing the separation before L
entries.summary: Constructs the weight cutoffs and a geometric separation certificate from BasicConditions. Its threshold L₀ is chosen once, then operatorMainConclusion_of_radialData is applied to every L ≥ L₀.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.magnetic_realization
entries.title: A002 · Classical realization
entries.summary: Admits, for every smooth, bounded real potential and all real b, λ, the self-adjoint realization of the magnetic test graph and its variational and classical correspondences.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.classical_standard_landau_resolvent
entries.title: Standard Landau resolvent
entries.summary: Proves the explicit proper-time kernel formula from the Gaussian heat equation, its initial limit, time integration, and Schur’s L² estimate. Closure of the test graph extends the identity to the actual operator domain. The realization certificate is an explicit argument; the former admission A003 is discharged.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.free_landau_resolvent_kernel
entries.title: Physical Landau resolvent representation
entries.summary: Derives the physical source representation from A002 and the proved standard kernel formula. Lean proves that the smooth L² solution lies in the closed domain and verifies B=bλ, ρ=λ²E, the magnetic phase, and the outside factor λ⁻².

entries.name: InfiniteZero.classical_radial_low_levels
entries.title: A004 · Radial harmonic approximation
entries.summary: Admits, for a smooth compactly supported nonpositive radial well with a unique nondegenerate negative minimum, a positive normalized radial ground state and harmonic-approximation bounds of order h^(3/2) for the first two semiclassical levels. The reference oscillator is specified by its full mode family. Lean proves the ordering of its first two modes, the unscaled gap limit, the min-max inequality on the orthogonal complement, and the application to the explicit core.

entries.name: InfiniteZero.classical_h2_point_evaluation
entries.title: Sobolev point evaluation
entries.summary: Proves that a fixed constant controls the value at the centre of the unit ball by the local H² norm of any smooth complex function. The proof uses a smooth cutoff, two applications of the fundamental theorem of calculus, Cauchy–Schwarz, and the proved H² multiplication bound. This theorem and the resulting uniform interior elliptic estimate have no admitted dependencies.

main_items.title: Infinitely many spectral crossings
main_items.summary: A positive, strictly increasing sequence tends to infinity and makes secondEnergy − groundEnergy exactly zero. Every sufficiently large crossing has a two-dimensional L² ground eigenspace containing both parities; the gap field supplies its isolation.

main_items.title: Infinitely many hopping zeros
main_items.summary: Another positive, strictly increasing sequence tends to infinity and makes canonicalHopping zero in ℂ. The coefficient is the actual physical integral formed from a normalized atomic state, independent of its choice at large coupling; the two zero sequences are not asserted to coincide.

main_items.title: Infinitely many parity changes
main_items.summary: Two divergent sequences satisfy 0 < pₙ < qₙ < pₙ₊₁: the ground state is simple and even at pₙ, and simple and odd at qₙ. Parity is full inversion x ↦ −x, expressed almost everywhere for L² classes.

scope_notes: The proof of thm_main depends on two classical admissions, A002 and A004. The dependency graph records which declarations use these admissions, directly or transitively.
The reference statement is thm:main in the manuscript. Its three conclusions concern eigenvalue crossings, zeros of the hopping coefficient, and changes of ground-state parity.

The code constructs neither a complete enumeration E₀ ≤ E₁ ≤ … of the discrete spectrum nor a spectral projection for an entire window. The first two levels are identified with the parity modes, and the gap above the ground eigenspace is established.
The main result asserts neither zero spacing, uniqueness of a zero between samples, nor the differentiated asymptotic remainders discussed elsewhere in the text.
The explicit numerical parameters specialize the family of potentials in the manuscript; the Lean construction verifies that they satisfy the required conditions.
Explanations summarize the mathematical content. The Lean and TeX source panels reproduce excerpts from the repository.
Dependency edges come from the Lean audit in docs/declarations.json. Reading guides and links to manuscript statements provide a separate guide to the argument.

assembly_steps.title: Fix the potential
assembly_steps.text: elementaryParameters fixes the scalars and both cutoffs; elementaryParameters_basicConditions verifies every elementary condition without admissions.

assembly_steps.title: Choose sufficient separation
assembly_steps.text: The weight cutoffs and separation certificate are constructed before L. The threshold L₀ then works for every L ≥ L₀.

assembly_steps.title: Construct the original estimates
assembly_steps.text: The ground states, sources, channels, and cosine asymptotic for the hopping are constructed from the classical interfaces. The Schur errors are controlled relative to the amplitude of the same channels.

assembly_steps.title: Pass from signs to the three conclusions
assembly_steps.text: Continuity and the oscillating phase provide alternating signs and exact zeros. The min/max identifications and physical modes give multiplicity, isolation, and parity changes.

assembly_steps.title: Instantiate the admissions and conclude
assembly_steps.text: mainConclusion combines A002 and A004 with the proved resolvent formula and elliptic estimate. elementaryPotential_main gives the result for the fixed witness, and thm_main then presents it in the constructed existential form.

reading_paths.title: Audit the assembly and trusted inputs
